newsitem.title: USA: Advanced Environmental sees Q2 sales $2mln.
newsitem.headline: Advanced Environmental sees Q2 sales $2mln.

text.p: Advanced Environmental Recycling Technologies Inc on Wednesday said it expected to report improved operating results on sales of more than $2 million for the second quarter ended June 30.
In addition, the company said it expected to report a one-time gain resulting from settlement of a previous fire claim and rebuilding of a plastic recycling facility
The company said it had written down its assets in an earlier quarter while the insurance claim was pending.
The company said it would announce its second quarter results at its annual shareholder meeting on July 25 at 1000 EST/1400 GMT.
